title: BEASLEY BROADCAST GROUP TO REPORT 2026 THIRD QUARTER FINANCIAL RESULTS, HOST CONFERENCE CALL AND WEBCAST ON NOVEMBER 13
body_markdown:
NAPLES, Florida, November 12, 2026 – Beasley Broadcast Group, Inc. (Nasdaq: BBGI) (“Beasley” or the “Company”), a multi-platform media company, announced today that it will report its 2026 third quarter financial results after the market closes on Friday, November 13, 2026. The Company will host a conference call and webcast at 4.30 p.m. ET that morning to review the results.


To access the conference call, interested parties may dial +1 833-461-5787 or +1 585-542-9983, conference ID 999 289 758 (domestic and international callers). Participants can also listen to a live webcast of the call at the Company’s website at[www.bbgi.com](https://events.q4inc.com/attendee/690189129) . Please allow 15 minutes to register and download and install any necessary software. Following its completion, a replay of the webcast can be accessed for five days on the Company’s website,[www.bbgi.com](http://www.bbgi.com/) .


Questions from analysts, institutional investors and debt holders may be e-mailed to ir@bbgi.com at any time up until 4.30 p.m. ET on November 13, 2026. Management will answer as many questions as possible during the conference call and webcast (provided the questions are not addressed in their prepared remarks).


**About Beasley Broadcast Group**


Beasley Broadcast Group, Inc. (www.bbgi.com) was founded in 1961 by George G. Beasley and owns a total of 47 AM and FM stations in 9 large- and mid-size markets in the United States. Beasley radio stations reach over 17 million unique consumers weekly over-the-air, online and on smartphones and tablets, and millions regularly engage with the Company’s brands and personalities through digital platforms such as Facebook, X, text, apps and email. For more information, please visit[www.bbgi.com](http://www.bbgi.com/) .


For further information, or to receive future Beasley Broadcast Group news announcements via e-mail, please contact Beasley Broadcast Group, at 239-263-5000 or email@bbgi.com.
